_comment: Example NapCat onebot11_<self_id>.json (lives inside the NapCat container at /app/napcat/config/onebot11_<self_id>.json). Copy values; pick generate 'token' yourself (keep SYNCHRONISED with napcat-cli's NoraCatConfig token config.json). host '0.0.0.0' so Docker port mapping reaches them.
_docker_port_mapping: OneBot11 HTTP server listens on container port `httpServers[*].port`; OneBot11 WebSocket server listens on container `websocketServers[*].port`. Publish them in your docker-compose ports block, e.g. ['18800:3000', '18801:3001']. NOTE: a docker run ports section may transpose host<->container — double check which port your napcat-cli connects to.
